untrusted_code_execution.mechanism: Pure Python ast.parse & ast.NodeVisitor without dynamic evaluation or execution

subprocess_sandbox.isolation_details: Human-in-the-loop authorization gate + dedicated subprocess.run with cwd restriction, timeout=30s, and captured output

multi_tenant_isolation.mechanism: Strict physical graph namespacing (workspace_{repo_id}) per tenant/repository in FalkorDB

cypher_injection_mitigation.mechanism: Parameterized Cypher parameters ($param) across all FalkorDB client operations

resource_cleanup.mechanism: GRAPH.DELETE / safe DETACH DELETE API for complete tenant decommissioning
